verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments platform with an AI docs assistant and an MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any control, policy, or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The AI assistant and MCP items describe developer tooling, not data-use guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
